ancient-fruit.name: Ancient Fruit
ancient-fruit.seed_note: Not sold in shops: craft Ancient Seeds from the Ancient Seed artifact, or make more in a Seed Maker.

coffee-bean.name: Coffee Bean
coffee-bean.seed_note: Not sold in shops: Dust Sprites in the Mines drop them, the Traveling Cart sometimes sells them (100-1,000g, or 2,500g), and after that you replant your own beans.

sweet-gem-berry.name: Sweet Gem Berry
sweet-gem-berry.seed_note: Rare Seeds: the Traveling Cart sells 1 to 5 for 1,000g each in Spring and Summer, and now and then for 600-1,000g in any season. A Seed Maker turns one berry into about two Rare Seeds.

special_use.title: Trade one for a Stardrop
special_use.text: Give one Sweet Gem Berry to the Old Master Cannoli statue in the northwest corner of the Secret Woods and it gives you a Stardrop, which raises your maximum energy for good. It works once per save; in multiplayer every player gets a Stardrop from that one berry. After that, sell the rest: it is not a fruit or vegetable, so it cannot go in a Keg, Preserves Jar or Dehydrator, and Tiller does not raise its price.

void-chicken.name: Void Chicken

acquisition.how: Void Chickens can be hatched by placing a Void Egg into an Incubator, taking 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) to incubate, or 4,500m (2d 21h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession. There is no other way to obtain a Void Chicken.

notes: The Animals page gives the interval once for its whole "Chickens" section ("Adult chickens will produce eggs every morning if fed."), which also lists the Void Chicken.

golden-chicken.name: Golden Chicken

acquisition.how: Golden Chickens can be hatched by placing a Golden Egg into an Incubator, taking 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) to incubate, or 4,500m (2d 21h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession.

egg.requirement: To obtain Golden Eggs and Golden Chickens, Perfection must be reached.

notes: The Animals page gives the interval once for its whole "Chickens" section ("Adult chickens will produce eggs every morning if fed."), which also lists the Golden Chicken.

acquisition.how: Dinosaurs can be hatched by placing a Dinosaur Egg into an Incubator, taking 18,000m (11d 6h 40m) to incubate, or 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession.

Ostriches can be hatched by placing an Ostrich Egg into an Ostrich Incubator, taking 15,000m (9d 10h) to incubate, or 7,500m (4d 18h 20m) with the Coopmaster Profession. An Ostrich Egg can be initially found by solving Journal Scrap #10, or as a random drop from the chests in the Volcano Dungeon.

sheep.name: Sheep
notes: A mature sheep grows in its coat every 3 days, if it is fed and has at least 70 happiness.
If the player has 900 or more Friendship with the sheep and has pet it at least one time, it will reduce it to every other day.

pig.name: Pig
notes: Truffles that are not gathered will stay on the ground until the next day.
truffles that are not gathered on the 28th day of a season disappear on the following morning (the 1st day of the new season).
Pigs have a 0.2% chance to dig up a Truffle Crab instead of a Truffle.
A Golden Animal Cracker can be given to any farm animal (except pigs) to permanently double its produce.
conditions: the pig has been let outside the barn
there are tiles available outside upon which to place a truffle
